title: Record cost and inference events for every harness run
narrative: Finance asks Nubble whether a harness run actually burned billable units. He runs a short one-shot job and checks the event log. He needs both an inference event and a cost event with non-zero units — the same signals he would forward to billing or a Grafana panel.
implementation:
CLI universe `cli:infer` via `CliInstrumentor` / `CliInferRunner` emits structured `EventLog` records for inference and cost (`CostAccountant` / `core:cost`, `core:inference`) on the same stream as graph lifecycle events. This is the baseline observability stream for every run — decisions, routing, and tools extend the same log rather than a separate ledger.

Covers: OBS-01.
validation: Harness `cli` scenarios `event_types.yaml` (exact baseline event types + positive cost units) and `event_timestamps.yaml` (clock-stamped inference/cost). Cassette `response.json`. Related: `tests/test_events.py`. Live: `MECHA_STORY_BACKEND=live`.
